followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Six dated vehicle-access blockades are supported as separate phases, within one repeated protest parent. Planned additional blockades and general countrywide protest days do not create extra observed phases. Vehicles using the Leușeni–Albița access road in both directions. The reports identify tractor obstruction; a general pedestrian prohibition or all Moldova–Romania border closure is not established. P1 begins 12 February 2024 and ends near midnight, retaining a 12–13 February bound. P2–P6 separately cover 13, 14, 15, 22 and 23 February, each with same-day restoration reports and no whole-day duration. The gaps remain open rather than joined. Farmers sought economic relief and government engagement. The Jobs, services and livelihoods code is attributed to protestors, not framed as an official government closure rationale. The two IPN originals timed out but were read as indexed article text. NewsMaker and five broadcast articles were read directly. Broadcast restoration updates often relay Customs or Border Police; multiple outlets do not automatically create independent operational observations. All six phases are unlocated pending B01. The access obstruction must be represented at the reviewed road/crossing scope and cannot be expanded to the entire bilateral frontier.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.

Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
